en.bgHint: Running in the background (not attached to a terminal). To stop: {cmd}
en.disclaimerBody: Enabling public access exposes this computer’s DSH (which can execute code) to the internet. Anyone with the public link and PIN can reach — and operate — your computer. Please confirm: ① use a strong custom PIN or keep the auto-generated one safe; ② turn public access OFF as soon as you’re done; ③ on a corporate/classified network, confirm compliance first.
en.disclaimerHint: Check "I understand" before enabling public access
en.downloading: ⏳ Downloading cloudflared (first run ~20-50MB, usually 1-2 min; instant afterward) · {s}s elapsed
en.error: ❌ Failed to enable: {detail} (you can retry; for proxy/VPN issues see the README)
en.feedback: 🙏 Questions? Open an issue on GitHub
en.lanDisabledHint: 🔒 LAN access is off — the QR code and link are unavailable (public access is unaffected). Tap "On" to restore.
en.lanHint: Scan to open once your phone is on the same Wi-Fi
en.lanPinOff: 🔓 PIN off — scan & go, no PIN (LAN devices only; public still requires PIN)
en.lanPinValue: 🔐 PIN: {pin} (required on the phone; separate from the public PIN)
en.lanToggleBodyOff: Once off, phones on the same Wi-Fi can no longer scan to connect (the LAN QR code and link stop working immediately). Public access is unaffected. Turn it off?
en.lanToggleBodyOn: Once on, phones on the same Wi-Fi can scan to connect (a LAN PIN is required by default). Turn it on?
en.mobileRightbarHint: Show the native right-sidebar entry; disable it for a compact phone header or keep it on for an unfolded display
en.namedHow: Create a tunnel in Cloudflare Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels and copy the token; point the hostname's Service at http://127.0.0.1:3081 (the proxy port). The URL stays fixed across restarts.
en.namedNeedCfg: Set the fixed domain and Tunnel Token first
en.namedRunningHint: Fixed domain (Cloudflare named tunnel) — the URL no longer changes on restart
en.namedSecurity: A fixed domain is long-lived and easier to scan — set a strong custom PIN too (the public PIN is not rotated on restart in this mode).
en.namedTakeEffect: Fixed-domain config saved — turn public access off and on again to take effect
en.pinCustomHint: custom PINs are not rotated on tunnel start
en.pinInvalid: PIN must be 8–64 characters (letters and digits only)
en.resetBody: This clears and restores defaults:n① Switches: LAN access on, access PIN on, mobile right sidebar on, LAN address auton② Public: mode back to random URL, Tunnel Token and fixed domain cleared, and any running tunnel is stoppedn③ PINs: both public and LAN become new random 8-character PINs (old ones stop working; the phone must re-enter)nnYour DSH sessions, models and plugin config are untouched. This cannot be undone.
en.resetDone: ✅ Factory reset done: settings cleared and PINs re-rolled (re-enter the PIN on your phone)
en.resetIntro: Temporary fallback when settings break: clear local config and re-roll random PINs (DSH sessions, models and plugin config are untouched)
en.slowHint: — taking long? Check for a proxy/VPN (e.g., Clash TUN)
en.starAsk: ⭐ Drop a Star if it helped — it makes the author’s day
en.subtitle: The phone shows this exact screen, live
en.title: 📱 Phone access
en.updatedAutoDetail: ✅ Updated — auto-restarting in progress, refresh shortly
en.updatedRestart: ✅ Updated to v{ver} — restart to apply
en.updatedRestartDetail: ✅ Updated — restart dsh web to apply
en.updateFailed: ❌ Failed: {err} (manual update: dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-pocket --latest -w)
en.wanEphemeralWarn: ⚠️ The public link is valid only for this session: it stops working after you close or restart, and may be reused by someone else for an unrelated site. Do not bookmark it — scan the CURRENT QR code from this page each time. For a permanent address use "Fixed domain" below.
en.wanHint: Scan from any network (the URL changes on every restart)
en.wanOffHint: Reachable from any network once enabled (a disclaimer is confirmed on each enable)
en.wanPin: 🔐 PIN: {pin} (changes each time the tunnel is enabled; required on the phone)
en.wanPinCustom: 🔐 PIN: {pin} (custom — not rotated on tunnel start)
